name: Filter & Sort Products by Tags
author: Daniel Esparza

sections.description:
Filter & Sort Products by Tags is a WooCommerce plugin that shows a row of buttons with your product tags and a dynamic grid of products that can be filtered.
Filtering is instant, which makes browsing large catalogs faster.

Main features:
* Instant product filtering by tag.
* Responsive grid (1 to 4 columns) with images, titles, prices and the add-to-cart button.
* Simple shortcode: [filter-sort-products-tags].
* limit attribute to set the maximum number of products (default 100): [filter-sort-products-tags limit="60"].
* Option to turn the plugin on or off from the admin.
* Built with Isotope.js for smooth filtering and animations.
* CSS and JS load only on pages that contain the shortcode.

Video

sections.installation:
1. Upload the filter-sort-products-tags folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress (WooCommerce must be active).
  3. (Optional) In the Filter & Sort Products admin menu you can turn the plugin on or off.
  4. Add the shortcode [filter-sort-products-tags] to any page or post to show the filter and the product grid.
sections.faq:
How do I use the shortcode?

Add [filter-sort-products-tags] to any page or post where you want the filter and the product grid.

How many products are shown?

Up to 100 by default. Change it with the limit attribute, for example [filter-sort-products-tags limit="60"].

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin requires WooCommerce and existing products in your store.

Can I customize the styles?

Yes. Override the plugin CSS classes from your theme or add your own styles, for example:
.filter-sort-products-tags-container, .filter-item, .filter-sort-products-tags-container-tags button, .active, etc.

What does the “Enable Plugin” option do?

It turns the plugin features on or off without uninstalling it. When it is off, the shortcode shows nothing.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Fixed a fatal error when WooCommerce is not active. Declared the WooCommerce dependency (Requires Plugins) and HPOS compatibility.
  • New limit shortcode attribute (default 100) instead of loading every product.
  • Responsive grid: 1 to 4 columns depending on the screen width.
  • CSS and JS now load only on pages that contain the shortcode.
  • The Isotope script handle is now prefixed (fspt-isotope) to avoid conflicts with themes.
  • Escaped the product image, title and link output.
  • Settings page: fixed the About link and the developer contact details.
  • Interface strings in English, ready for translation on translate.wordpress.org.
  • Uninstall no longer tries to delete an option that does not exist.
  • Plugin header: added Requires at least, Requires PHP and License URI.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: [filter-sort-products-tags] shortcode, Isotope.js integration, admin settings, base styles and filtering script.
